components.title: Access Control Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Access Control domain.

implemented-requirements.description: AC.L2-3.1.6: Use non-privileged accounts for non-security functions
AC.L2-3.1.8: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts
AC.L2-3.1.9: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with CUI rules
AC.L2-3.1.10: Use session lock with pattern-hiding after inactivity
AC.L2-3.1.15: Authorize remote execution of privileged commands and remote access to security info
AC.L2-3.1.16: Authorize wireless access prior to allowing connections
AC.L2-3.1.17: Protect wireless access using authentication and encryption
AC.L2-3.1.18: Control connection of mobile devices
AC.L2-3.1.19: Encrypt CUI on mobile devices and platforms
AC.L2-3.1.21: Limit use of portable storage devices on external systems

components.title: Awareness Training Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Awareness and Training domain.

implemented-requirements.description: AT.L2-3.2.1: Ensure personnel are aware of security risks and applicable policies
AT.L2-3.2.2: Ensure personnel are trained to carry out their security duties
AT.L2-3.2.3: Provide security awareness training on recognizing insider threat

components.title: Configuration Management Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Configuration Management domain.

implemented-requirements.description: CM.L2-3.4.9: Control and monitor user-installed software

components.title: Identification Authentication Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Identification and Authentication domain.

implemented-requirements.description: IA.L2-3.5.5: Prevent reuse of identifiers for a defined period
IA.L2-3.5.11: Obscure feedback of authentication information

components.title: Incident Response Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Incident Response domain.

implemented-requirements.description: IR.L2-3.6.1: Establish an operational incident-handling capability
IR.L2-3.6.2: Track document and report incidents to designated officials
IR.L2-3.6.3: Test the organizational incident response capability

components.title: Maintenance Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Maintenance domain.

implemented-requirements.description: MA.L2-3.7.1: Perform maintenance on organizational systems
MA.L2-3.7.2: Provide controls on the tools techniques and personnel used for maintenance
MA.L2-3.7.3: Sanitize equipment removed for off-site maintenance of CUI
MA.L2-3.7.4: Check media containing diagnostic/test programs for malicious code
MA.L2-3.7.6: Supervise maintenance activities of personnel without required access

components.title: Media Protection Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Media Protection domain.

implemented-requirements.description: MP.L2-3.8.3: Sanitize or destroy media containing CUI before disposal or reuse
MP.L2-3.8.4: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations
MP.L2-3.8.5: Control access to media and maintain accountability during transport
MP.L2-3.8.7: Control the use of removable media on system components
MP.L2-3.8.8: Prohibit use of portable storage devices with no identifiable owner

components.title: Personnel Security Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Personnel Security domain.

implemented-requirements.description: PS.L2-3.9.1: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to CUI
PS.L2-3.9.2: Protect CUI during and after personnel actions (termination/transfer)

components.title: Physical Protection Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Physical Protection domain.

implemented-requirements.description: PE.L2-3.10.1: Limit physical access to systems equipment and operating environments
PE.L2-3.10.2: Protect and monitor the physical facility and support infrastructure
PE.L2-3.10.3: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity
PE.L2-3.10.4: Maintain audit logs of physical access
PE.L2-3.10.5: Control and manage physical access devices
PE.L2-3.10.6: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites

components.title: Risk Assessment Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the Risk Assessment domain.

implemented-requirements.description: RA.L2-3.11.1: Periodically assess risk to operations and assets from system operation

components.title: System & Communications Protection Policy
components.description: Organizational policy satisfying administrative practices in the System and Communications Protection domain.

implemented-requirements.description: SC.L2-3.13.7: Prevent split tunneling for remote devices
SC.L2-3.13.12: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative devices and provide indication
SC.L2-3.13.13: Control and monitor use of mobile code
SC.L2-3.13.14: Control and monitor use of Voice over Internet Protocol
